articles.title: Silver wool fabric: establish the specification
articles.deck: A material review for interior buyers. Confirm the exact construction and project conditions before requesting an offer.
sections: The Silver product page lists wool composition, width and a weight notation. Treat these as supplier statements for this item, rather than a specification for every Burel fabric.
Confirm the weight unit, usable width, required quantity and intended installation. Trade price, MOQ, stock and project lead time remain unconfirmed.

articles.title: Burel Factory: a mill to evaluate for your project
articles.deck: A supplier profile for material buyers reviewing wool textiles and interior applications.
sections: Burel Factory describes itself as a Portuguese wool brand and working textile mill in Manteigas. Its range includes fabric and finished interior products.
No supplier onboarding, factory audit or commercial relationship has been completed for this review. Request the project-specific technical sheet and quotation before shortlisting.

articles.title: Specify the application before comparing offers
articles.deck: Prepare a useful enquiry around material, installation and commercial conditions.
sections: Fabric by the metre suits buyers who arrange fabrication. A finished piece shifts fabrication to the supplier. A bespoke interior solution needs a project brief and installation details. These are procurement routes to assess, not confirmed offers.

Ask about samples and their cost. For colour-critical work, confirm dye-lot planning. Obtain matching quotation terms for quantity, destination and delivery. Retail and spatial-project return policies differ: request the applicable written terms.
